reviews.text:
I was looking at the section for therapeutic dog food when a store clerk asked me, "Do you have a dog? Is it sick with kidneys?" I replied, "It's not that it's sick yet, I'm just looking for something for when it might get sick in the future." She laughed and said, "Oh, really! Come back when it gets sick," which surprised me.
I said, "How awful!" but she just kept laughing. Was she kidding me?
Her comment, implying I was happy about my dog ​​getting sick, was extremely rude and offensive.
The food items and dog costumes were so cute and stylish! ✨🐶 There weren't many cat items, though. …

I regularly bring my dog ​​in for grooming. Their technical skills are, needless to say, exceptionally outstanding, and I am extremely satisfied. In addition, they provide meticulous health management that carefully considers the needs of both my dog ​​and myself, and offer accurate advice, allowing me to consult them with complete confidence regarding any concerns or questions I may have.
I bought treats, cakes, and toys for my dog, but the customer service was poor, and they made a mistake with the bill, which was disappointing. ☹️
There were fewer types of products than I expected.

There's an elevator that you can take your dog in with you, which is very helpful. 
The location is close and convenient, and the staff kindly and carefully check on your dog every time, so it's very reassuring. 
Thank you so much as always

Why was there no service at all?
Other than when paying the bill, there was not a single word of "Welcome" or "Thank you."
Is this discrimination against foreigners?
